observations.why: Imperative directive issued without justification or appeal — the speaker's authority to command erasure is asserted by the act itself, and the bare imperative carries insistence.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge about the PostgreSQL to QuantumDB migration.

observations.why: Imperative command to delete information, performed as a direct order with no rationale offered — positional authority claimed by the act of commanding, insistence in the bare imperative form.

mints.name: DirectiveErasureCommand
mints.title: command to forget or remove knowledge, issued as a bare imperative
mints.frame: Is the speaker asserting authority by commanding erasure or forgetting, without offering rationale or inviting consultation?
